d:
Hum Hai Jhalle is an anthem for those embracing the joy of doing nothing. This track celebrates a carefree, unemployed life, where contentment comes from simply being no hustle, just happiness in the freedom of idleness.
Song Credits:
Track Name: Hum hai Jhalle
Written & Performed By: Mad Trip
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna
Primary Artist: Mad Trip
Track Name: Hum hai Jhalle
Singer/Performed By/Cast: Mad Trip
